While memory costs are projected to be the most expensive component in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the situation with the iPhone Duo could be different. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive display supply deal with Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and later models," with each panel costing approximately US$250.

The leaker also noted that the panel is "one of the most expensive core components in the entire device," which is hardly surprising.

While there are no reliable reports yet on the iPhone Duo's projected bill of materials, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled material it contains, by breaking down the costs of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components.
